title: Microsoft 365 outage drags on as company observes ‘limited recovery’
summary: A map posted by Downdetector on X showed the outage affected users across the Americas, and parts of Europe, Asia and Africa
llm_summary: Microsoft 365 is still experiencing a widespread outage, with the company reporting only a “limited recovery” after the disruption began. Downdetector’s map shows the impact spanning the Americas and reaching into parts of Europe, Asia and Africa, leaving millions of users unable to access core services
